adjudication.full_rescue: M0 claim-grade FAIL -> one X1 claim-grade PASS, no second correction, no gold leakage
adjudication.persistent_fail: scoreable failure remains after allowed X1
adjudication.quarantine: unsoundness/constraint safety cannot be established without invalid inference

contest.name: AtCoder Regular Contest 213 (Div. 1)
contest.selection_rule: Take the three highest-score non-A tasks from a fresh completed ARC not opened in V21-V31, using contest/task metadata only.

runtime.M0: one-shot implementation from official statement only
runtime.X1: at most one bounded correction from frozen verifier counterexample only

verification.global_state_gate: If candidate compresses persistent/global latent state into local/bounded state, rescue promotion requires proof-equivalent invariant or independent scalable/reference oracle beyond bounded-small exhaustive.
